remarks: Attention All Investors!!! Potential-Potential-Potential...Nicely kept 2-Family house in highly sought out South Norwalk area with great income opportunity and potential for more. This Multi-Family Colony sits on a level lot with 2 separate units, both 3-Bedroom. Has a 4 Car Detached Garage. The Lower-Level apartment has 3 Bedrooms, a Living Room with Fireplace, Dining Room, eat-in kitchen, large pantry/laundry room with a washer machine and 1 full bath, also includes an enclosed front porch. The Upper-Level apartment has 3-Bedrooms, Living Room with fireplace, Dining Room, eat-in kitchen, large pantry/laundry room and full bath. This Structure has separate entrances in the front and rear of the building, also with a separate entrance to a very large walk-up attic with many possibilities. Each Unit has Hardwood Floors Throughout. Access to the basement from inside and outside with a full walkout door to the backyard. Off-Street Parking for your tenants and an oversized driveway.  HIGHEST AND BEST MUST BE SUBMITTED BY MONDAY OCTOBER 21ST BY 5PM.
